prompt:
References:
@Image 1: rendering style only; not character identity or costume.
@Image 2: material craftsmanship style only; not character identity, clothing design or colors.

Task:
Image-to-Image (I2I). Create an original design.

Subject:
Garment and footwear material study for Sinag. A fitted aubergine woven-fiber superhero suit with cream curved panels at the torso and outer calves, a marigold sculpted cropped shoulder jacket ending above the waist, a small raised abstract sun ornament on the jacket chest, cream woven forearm gauntlets, and cream tall angular boots with aubergine inset panels and marigold segmented soles. A short cream split sunray cape is permanently fixed at both jacket shoulders: two tapered cloth tails ending near the knees, separated by a clear center gap. 

Setting:
Plain light-gray studio backdrop in narrow gaps between details.

Style:
Apply the tactile handmade 3D rendering of @Image 1: appealing stylized anatomy, dimensional woven cloth and sculpted material textures. Apply the craftsmanship of @Image 2 to the new outfit: visible fiber weave, stitched seams, lightly frayed edges, tiny paint speckles and restrained scuffs. Keep the specified new palette and garment design.

Lighting:
Soft even neutral studio light, gentle fill, neutral white balance, matte cloth, consistent exposure.

Composition:
Exactly three equal-height vertical macro panels side by side, separated by narrow plain gutters. Left: tightly cropped marigold jacket chest cloth, raised abstract sun ornament and cream shoulder attachment cloth. The upper edge cuts through marigold chest cloth below the neckline; fabric completely fills the upper-left edge. Collar and anything above it are outside the image. Center: aubergine waist weave, cream torso panel and two cream cape tails separated by a center gap; show raised fibers, reinforced hems and stitching. Right: cream woven forearm gauntlet beside the cream angular tall boot, aubergine boot inset and marigold segmented sole; show tiny scuffs and layered material. Fill each panel edge to edge with tightly cropped garment or footwear surfaces. The panels are macro photographs of the costume laid on invisible supports. Only cloth and footwear fill the frame; no person or mannequin is visible. Show no head, face, eyes, mouth, ears, hair or portrait. Use the same palette, seams, garment construction and material treatment in every panel.

Constraints:
Three garment-only detail panels; no full-body view, portrait, face panel or additional panel. Purely abstract decorative relief, no exact symbols, sacred motifs or known superhero design. No text, captions, logos, watermark, halo, weapons or held objects.
